name: qdadm-consumer-smoke
description: Consumer smoke fixture (#1024): typechecks the PACKED qdadm tarball the way a real strict-TS consumer does. @quazardous/qdadm is installed by tools/consumer-smoke/run.sh from `npm pack`, never from a link. vanilla-jsoneditor is declared here on purpose (#1901): it is an optional peer of qdadm, so a fixture that imports /editors must ask for it the way a consumer who chose the editor would. @vitejs/plugin-vue is here for the vite build step (#4140); sass is deliberately absent, since an app must build without it.
